main_text.head: QUAEST. 3. Utrum qui insignibus vel armis alterius familiæ usus est, duello provocari possit?
main_text.p: Carpzov. de Leg. Reg.Ger-man cap. 10.sect. 7.art.18.IN tantum de opinatâ quâ existumatione, & honoris apicibus inter se contendunt viri nobiles, ut etiam justissimam certaminis singularis ineundi causam existument, si de præcedentiæ jure oriatur quæstio. Et quod huic malo cõfine est, si infignia nobilium aliquis assumpserit, quinon erat de fa-miliâ, nonnisi duelloarmorum furtum vindicari posse censent. Nulla tamen ratione, nullo fundamento. Etsi enim grande dedecus sit, nobis eripi nostra infignia, quæ sigillo nostro comparantur, & ex quibus dignitas dependet familiæ. Non tamen ideo licebit eorum gratiâ, aliquem duello provocare, multo minus occidere. Cùm

page.notes: The hyphenated marginal note "Reg.Ger-man" is split across lines as printed. "quinon" is printed as one word. The faint "Google" watermark at the bottom right is a digitiser's mark and is left out. No other doubtful readings.
